communication_goal: 确认默认权限与无编辑权限时的界面。
image_prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE standalone educational scene illustration, square 1024x1024. Pure SOLID BLACK background, bright clean WHITE line art. Minimalist adult stick figures with circular heads, simple expressive faces, thin limbs, polished programmer workplace comic aesthetic. No colors, gradients, shading or photographic rendering. Single coherent scene, no panels. People and props central, approximately x=180..820 and y=220..790 on 0..1000 canvas. Generous blank space at top y<180, bottom y>850 and sides for later learning labels. Learning props recognizable and fully visible. Conversation gestures. NO speech bubbles, letters, numbers, captions, logos, watermark, readable code or writing. Simple abstract UI symbols allowed. Scene: Two adult stick-figure coworkers sit at a desk, one on LEFT and one on RIGHT. Between them is one large open laptop, angled front-facing, with the WHOLE laptop screen, hinge and keyboard clearly visible. Screen shows abstract report rectangles and a small outlined empty button, without any letters or numbers. One points near the screen without covering the laptop, the other listens. No other props.

image_review.summary: 通过：单幅双人黑底白线火柴人，底图无文字、学习道具可辨认；完整可见的笔记本电脑本体可定位。 其他3词保持语境标签，无编造动作或身份框。 实际1254像素尺寸的裁剪检查后修正框范围，加入边缘余量保护完整道具。
